n-k-k10-04.title: Isaziso esinye, abamelwane ababini
n-k-k10-04.topic: Ukushwankathela isaziso esisemthethweni ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa yimida yaso
n-k-k10-04.goal: Fumana umgca wesishwankathelo otshintsha umda wexesha wesaziso, uze ubhale kwakhona isaziso kwiqela lencoko yabamelwane nanjengesikhumbuzo esithethwayo kumamelwane osokolileyo, ugcine umhla, iiyure kunye nesakhiwo kuchanekile.
n-k-k10-04.material:
Iofisi yolawulo ibeke isaziso. Uhlala kwi-101동.

[단수 안내]
배관 점검 공사로 10월 25일 토요일 오전 9시부터 오후 2시까지 101동 전 세대의 물이 나오지 않습니다. 공사가 일찍 끝나면 물이 먼저 나올 수 있습니다. 단수 전에 필요한 물을 미리 받아 두시기 바라며, 공사 후 처음 나오는 물은 누런색일 수 있으니 잠시 틀어 둔 뒤 사용하시기 바랍니다.
n-k-k10-04.prereq.0: Uyazi 합쇼체, 해요체 kunye nesihloko sembeko -(으)세요
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.prompt: Umamelwane wenze izishwankathelo ezine ezimfutshane zesaziso. Esiphi esitshintsha intsingiselo?
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.hint.0: Phinda ufunde isaziso uze ubhale iinyani zaso (nini, phi, yintoni ekufuneka uyenze). Emva koko thelekisa isishwankathelo ngasinye nohlu lwakho.
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.hint.1: Khangela nasiphi na isivakalisi esenza ixesha libe nde, lifutshane okanye lingabhidekanga kunokuba isaziso sithi.
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.r.a: Oku kugcina umhla, iiyure nesakhiwo ngokuchanekileyo njengoko isaziso sinjalo.
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.r.b: Isaziso sithi amanzi anokubuya kwangethuba ukuba umsebenzi uphela kwangethuba.
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.r.c: Isaziso sithi amanzi okuqala emva komsebenzi anokuba mfusa kwaye kufuneka ahambe ixesha elithile.
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.explain: '하루 종일' inweba ukunqunyanyiswa kweeyure ezintlanu (9:00-14:00) kuba yimini yonke, nto leyo eya kwenza abantu bacebe kakubi.
n-k-k10-04.s.s2.prompt: Bhala umyalezo omfutshane (izivakalisi ezi-2-3) weqela lencoko labamelwane ngesiKorea, ngokuhle kwe-해요체. Gcina umhla, iiyure, isakhiwo kunye neengcebiso zamanzi kuchanekile.
n-k-k10-04.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala iinyani ezine ekufuneka zisinde: nini, kude kube nini, ngubani achaphazelekayo, yintoni ekufuneka ayenze kuqala.
n-k-k10-04.s.s2.hint.1: Phinda uthi nganye nge-해요체 ephucukileyo uze utshintshe amabinzana aqinileyo esaziso ngamagama encoko.
n-k-k10-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba umamelwane ofunda umyalezo wam kuphela uya kwazi ngqo nini nakweyiphi indawo amanzi aya kuphela?
n-k-k10-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ivakala njengencoko phakathi kwabamelwane, ingenjalo nje ngesaziso?
n-k-k10-04.s.s3.prompt: Udibana nomamelwane osokolileyo kwi-elevator. Yithi into ephambili ngezivakalisi ezinye okanye ezibini ezithethwayo ngesiKorea, ngembeko (honorific). Gcina usuku, iiyure kunye nengcebiso.
n-k-k10-04.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngokubiza umamelwane ngembeko (어르신, 할머니, 할아버지 ...).
n-k-k10-04.s.s3.hint.1: Sebenzisa -(으)세요 okanye -(으)시- kwizinto umamelwane ekufuneka azenze, kwaye gcina iiyure zifutshane.
n-k-k10-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ndingathetha njalo na nomntu omdala endimbeka?
n-k-k10-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba umamelwane unokwenza ngokwalo myalezo kuphela (usuku, iiyure, ukulungiselela amanzi)?

n-k-k10-01.title: Ngubani othethe, kwaye ngamandla kangakanani?
n-k-k10-01.topic: Intetho eshiwo ngomnye: ukuthi ngubani nobungakanani bamandla ebango
n-k-k10-01.goal: Thelekisa isishwankathelo somfundi nerekhodi yoqobo yeendaba, ufumane imigca eyibika gwenxa isithethi, ubize uhlobo lotshintsho, uze uphinde ubhale umgca omnye ngaphandle kokuphazamisa.
n-k-k10-01.material:
Umfundi wephephandaba lesikolo washwankathela indibano yoluntu. Ngezantsi ngamazwi ncam abathethi emva koko isishwankathelo somfundi.

[간담회 발언 기록] 주제: 전통시장 주차장 유료화
박 시장: "내년 3월부터 시범 운영을 검토하고 있습니다. 아직 확정된 것은 아닙니다."
김 상인회장: "유료화되면 손님이 줄어들까 걱정입니다. 첫 30분은 무료로 해 주셨으면 합니다."
이 교수: "다른 도시에서는 유료화 후 주차 회전율이 높아졌다는 연구가 있습니다. 다만 상인 매출에 미친 영향은 도시마다 달랐습니다."
n-k-k10-01.thinking.1: Ukubona utshintsho kwindlela ibango eliqiniswa ngayo
n-k-k10-01.thinking.2: Ukubhala kwakhona ingxelo ukuze ihlale ithembekile
n-k-k10-01.prereq.1: Uyazi intetho eshiwo ngomnye (-다고 했다) kunye ne--(으)ㄹ까 걱정이다
n-k-k10-01.s.s1.prompt: Imigca emibini yesishwankathelo somfundi ayihambelani noko ithethe isithethi esibizwe ngegama. Khetha omnye wawo (nawuphi na uyabala).
n-k-k10-01.s.s1.hint.0: Thatha umgca ngamnye uze ufumane umntu obizwayo kwirekhodi.
n-k-k10-01.s.s1.hint.1: Thelekisa ibango emgceni namazwi omntu lowo: ingaba libango elifanayo, elithethwe ngumntu omnye?
n-k-k10-01.s.s1.hint.2: Ukuba umgca ubonakala uhambelana, wubeke ecaleni kwesivakalisi serekhodi esisuka kuso uthelekise igama ngegama.
n-k-k10-01.s.s1.explain: Umgca 2 uguqula inkxalabo yenkokeli yabarhwebi ('줄어들까 걱정입니다') ibe luqikelelo olungqongqo ('단언했다'). Umgca 5 unika ingxelo yombhali wetyala malunga nophando kwimeya. Imigca 1, 3, 4 no-6 ihambelana nerekhodi.
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.prompt: Imigca emibini iphosakele. Zimbini iinkcazo ezifanayo noko kwaphosakala kuyo?
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.hint.0: Chaza ingxaki yomgca ngamnye ophosakeleyo ngebinzana elinye phambi kokujonga ukhetho.
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.hint.1: Gqiba kwisigqibo ngasinye ukuba senzeka emgceni owukhethileyo okanye kwawo akukho.
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.r.b: Yomibini imigca ephosakeleyo igcina amanani (3월, 30분) njengoko ebenjalo; ukuphazamiseka kwenye indawo.
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.r.d: Isicelo semizuzu engama-30 yamahala sibikwe njengesicelo ('요청했다') emgceni 3, kwaye oko kuchanekile.
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.explain: Omnye umgca unika ingxelo yophando yombhali wetyala kwimeya; omnye uphucula i-'걱정입니다' ibe sisiphumo esiqinisekileyo.
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.prompt: Phinda ubhale umgca ophosakeleyo malunga ne-상인회장 ukuze ubike amazwi akhe ngaphandle kokuphazamisa. Bhala ngesiKorean (isimbo seendaba, umz. -다고 말했다) okanye ngesiNgesi.
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qala isivakalisi ngomntu obizwa lirekhodi, emva koko uthi lo mntu waziva okanye wacela ntoni.
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.hint.1: Khetha isenzi okanye isimamva esihambelana ne-'I am worried that...' kunokuba 'it will happen'.
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba isenzi sam okanye isimamva sibonisa inkxalabo kunokuqiniseka?
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba i-상인회장 ingafunda isivakalisi sam ithi 'ewe, yiyo leyo endiyithethileyo'?
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.model.2: Intloko yomanyano labarhwebi yathi ikhathazekile ukuba abathengi abambalwa banokuza.

n-k-k10-02.title: Ngawaphi amaxesha okuziqhelisa asindayo kuwo wonke umthetho?
n-k-k10-02.topic: Isaziso esinegatshana lomgaqo-nkqubo: ukufumana zonke ukhetho olusebenzayo
n-k-k10-02.goal: Funda isaziso segumbi leklabhu esinomthetho wexesha lokugqibela, ixesha lesidlo sasemini, ukuvalwa kweempelaveki nomgaqo-nkqubo wexesha lovavanyo, ufumane amaxesha okuziqhelisa amathathu kwiintsuku ezahlukeneyo athobela yonke imithetho, uze ucele elinye ngesiKorean.
n-k-k10-02.material:
Namhlanje yi-10월 10일, 월요일. Ibhendi yakho ifuna ukubhukisha igumbi leklabhu namhlanje.

[동아리방 사용 안내]
1. 사용 신청은 사용일 3일 전까지 받습니다.
2. 사용 시간은 오전 10시부터 오후 8시까지이며, 한 팀이 한 번에 쓸 수 있는 시간은 3시간 이내입니다.
3. 낮 12시부터 오후 1시까지는 점심시간이므로 사용할 수 없습니다.
4. 토요일과 일요일에는 문을 열지 않습니다.
5. 단, 시험 기간인 10월 17일부터 19일까지는 사용할 수 없습니다.

밴드 친구의 문자: "우리 공연이 22일이라 21일까지는 연습을 끝내야 해요. 연습은 한 번에 2시간 이상 해야 하고요."
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.prompt: Imeko 1 ithi izicelo ziyavalwa iintsuku ezintathu phambi kosuku lokusetyenziswa. Ukuba usebenzisa namhlanje (i-10), ngawaphi amaxesha okusetyenziswa oku akuvumelayo?
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.hint.0: Buza: ngosuku luphi lokusetyenziswa 'namhlanje' lizizo ngqo iintsuku ezintathu ngaphambili?
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba ngaba usuku olulandelayo lwenza isicelo sibe sikhawulezile okanye sihlwile kunexesha lokugqibela.
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.o.a: Yi-13 okanye nawuphi na usuku olulandelayo
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.r.b: Oko kujika isalathiso: umthetho umisela usuku lokuqala onokubhukisha, hayi lokugqibela.
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.r.c: '-까지' inika umda, hayi usuku olunye ncam; kuvumelekile namhla olulandelayo.
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.o.d: Yi-7 okanye nawuphi na usuku olulandelayo
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.r.d: Oko kubala iintsuku ezintathu emva ukusuka namhlanje, kodwa umthetho ubala ukusuka kusuku lokusetyenziswa.
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.explain: Ukusebenzisa nge-10 zizizo ngqo iintsuku ezintathu phambi kwe-13, ngoko i-13 lusuku lokuqala lokusetyenziswa kwaye namhla olulandelayo nawo asebenza.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.prompt: Fumana amaxesha okuziqhelisa ama-3 kwiintsuku ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo ezanelisa isaziso nombhalo womdlali kunye. d = usuku ngoMvulo, s = iyure yokuqala kwiwotshi yeeyure ezingama-24 (오후 2시 = 14), t = iiyure zokuziqhelisa.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ikhalenda ukususela ku-10: usuku ngalunye lweveki luyintoni? I-10 nguMvulo.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.hint.1: Chitha iintsuku kuqala (kukhawuleza kakhulu, kuhlwile kakhulu, impelaveki, umgaqo-nkqubo), emva koko ukhethe iiyure.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.hint.2: Jonga iwotshi ekugqibeleni: qala ngo-10 okanye emva koko, gqiba ngo-20, gcina i-12-13 ikhululekile, kwaye ube ngeeyure ezi-2-3 ubude.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Ikhawuleza kakhulu: ixesha lokugqibela lesicelo yiintsuku ezi-3 phambi kosuku lokusetyenziswa.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.fail.c5: Ixesha liqala kwangoko kakhulu okanye liphela emva kokuvalwa.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.fail.c6: Ukuziqhelisa kufuneka kube ngeeyure ezi-2 ubuncinane kwaye iklabhu ivumela ubuninzi be-3.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.fail.c7: Ixesha liyadibana nexesha lesidlo sasemini le-12:00-13:00.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.explain: Ngeentsuku ezine kuphela ezisebenzayo: i-13 ne-14 (ngeLwesine, ngeLwesihlanu) kunye ne-20 ne-21 (ngeLwesine, ngeLwesihlanu). I-15-16 yimpelaveki, i-17-19 lixesha lovavanyo (umgaqo-nkqubo), i-12 ikhawuleza kakhulu, kwaye i-22 ihlwile kakhulu. Ngosuku ngalunye iiyure kufuneka ziphephe isidlo sasemini zihlale ngaphakathi kwe-10:00-20:00.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha elinye ELOKUZIQHELISA lakho uze ubhale umyalezo omfutshane wesiKorean (onembeko) kumphathi wegumbi leklabhu ucela lona. Nika usuku nexesha.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Vula ngesibingelelo okanye usuku, emva koko ixesha.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Phelisa ngesicelo esinembeko esifana ne--고 싶습니다 okanye i-신청합니다.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingaba usuku namaxesha ahambelana nelinye lamaxesha endawakhileyo?

n-k-k10-03.title: Ingaba ivenkile inokwala le-refund?
n-k-k10-03.topic: Imithetho enomgaqo-nkqubo: yiyiphi inyaniso egqiba ityala
n-k-k10-03.goal: Fumana ukuba yiyiphi inyaniso enye engekhoyo egqiba isicelo se-refund phantsi komthetho onomgaqo-nkqubo, uxele oko sele kunokuthethwa, uze ucele inyaniso engekhoyo ngembeko ngesiKorean.
n-k-k10-03.material:
Imithetho ye-refund yevenkile nesicelo sekhasimende.

[환불 안내]
1. 구매일로부터 7일 이내에 신청하시면 환불해 드립니다.
2. 포장을 뜯었거나 사용한 상품은 환불이 되지 않습니다.
3. 단, 상품에 불량이 있는 경우에는 구매일로부터 30일 이내에 포장이나 사용 여부와 상관없이 환불해 드립니다.

[주문 내역] 무선 이어폰 1개 / 구매일: 10월 3일
오늘은 10월 12일입니다. 손님: "이어폰이 생각보다 별로예요. 환불해 주세요."
n-k-k10-03.thinking.2: Ukuphendula kuphela ukuya apho iinyaniso zivumela khona
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.prompt: Ungumabhalane. Yiyiphi inyaniso ENYE engekhoyo eya kutshintsha ukuba i-refund iyenzeka na?
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.hint.0: Kuqala sebenza ukuba zingaphi iintsuku ezidlulileyo ukususela ekuthengeni uze uthelekise nomthetho wokuqala.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.hint.1: Emva koko fumana umthetho onokusancedisa ikhasimende kwaye ubone oko ukufunayo.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.o.a: Ukuba ikhasimende lihlawule ngekhadi okanye ngemali.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.r.a: Imithetho ayikhankanyi ukuba umthengi uhlawule njani.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.r.b: Umda weentsuku ezi-7 sele uphelile, ngoko iphakheji evaliweyo yodwa ayifaneleki ukubuyiselwa kwemali, kwaye umthetho 3 awuyihoyi iphakheji.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.r.d: Irekhodi lomyalelo sele libonisa umhla wokuthenga, kwaye imithetho ayicelli risithi.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.explain: Ukubala ukusuka ngomhla we-10월 3일, namhlanje lusuku lwe-9, ngoko umthetho 1 awusasebenzi. Kuphela umthetho 3 onokuphinda unikeze imbuyekezo, kwaye ixhomekeke ekubeni kukho isiphoso na.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.prompt: Ngokusekelwe kuphela kwezo zaziwayo ngoku, yintoni umbhali onokuyithetha ngokuchanekileyo?
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.hint.0: Hlula oko izinto eziyaziwayo sele zikugqibile kwiko ziyishiya ivulekile.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.hint.1: Jonga ukhetho ngalunye ukuze ufumane inyani eyongezwayo ekungazange ichazwe kwimeko, okanye umthetho ashiywe ngaphandle.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.a: Imbuyekezo iyenzeka, kuba isicelo sikwiintsuku ezi-7.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.r.a: Ukusuka ngomhla we-10월 3일 ukuya kowe-10월 12일 ziintsuku ezi-9, ezidlula umda weentsuku ezi-7.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.b: Imbuyekezo yokutshintsha ingqondo idlulile kumda, kodwa imveliso enesiphoso ingaqhubeka ifanelekile.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.c: Imbuyekezo ayenzeki kwimeko ephi, kuba ziphelile iintsuku ezi-7.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.r.c: Oku akuwuhoyi umthetho 3, onika iintsuku ezingama-30 xa kukho isiphoso.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.d: Imbuyekezo iyenzeka kuphela ukuba iphakheji ayikavulwa.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.r.d: Iphakheji engavulwanga ibalulekile kuphela ngaphakathi kweentsuku ezi-7; emva koko, akukho nto kwimithetho enika imbuyekezo yemveliso engavulwanga.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.e: Imbuyekezo ayenzeki, kuba iphakheji mhlawumbi yayivuliwe.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.r.e: Akukho nto kwimeko ethi iphakheji yayivuliwe; oku kuthatha nje into engaqinisekanga.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.explain: Umbhali onokuthetha oko kulandela kwiinyani: akukho mbuyekezo xa umntu engayithandi nje imveliso emva kweentsuku ezi-7, kodwa impendulo inokutshintsha ukuba imveliso inesiphoso.
n-k-k10-03.s.s3.prompt: Phendula umthengi ngesiKorea (ngembeko). Yithi umda weentsuku ezi-7 sele uphelile kwimbuyekezo yokutshintsha ingqondo, emva koko buza into enye oyifunayo ukuze ukwazi ukugqiba.
n-k-k10-03.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngokunika isizathu somthetho wokuqala, ngokufutshane nangembeko.
n-k-k10-03.s.s3.hint.1: Emva koko phinda ufunde imithetho emithathu uze ubuze ngenyani engekabikho kwimeko.
n-k-k10-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ndiyawuchaza na umzekelo wokuba kutheni impendulo ingekho 'ewe' okwangoku?
n-k-k10-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba umbuzo wam ucela inyani enye egqibela ityala?

n-k-k10-05.title: I-'ewe' eyathetha hayi
n-k-k10-05.topic: Ukuphendula umbuzo ongaphikisiyo: 네 kunye 아니요
n-k-k10-05.goal: Hlaziya indlela oyifundayo 네 yodwa emva kombuzo ongaphikisiyo njengoko incoko ibonisa ukungaqondani, khetha indlela ecacileyo yokuphendula, uze ulungise ukungaqondani ngesiKorea.
n-k-k10-05.material: Usebenza inkampani. Intloko yesebe lakho (부장님) ikubuza ngentlanganiso yengomso. Nobabini nithetha ngembeko.
n-k-k10-05.thinking.0: Ukubona ukuba impendulo emfutshane inokufundwa ngeendlela ezimbini
n-k-k10-05.thinking.1: Ukuhlaziya indlela ofunda ngayo xa kuvela impendulo yomnye umntu
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.prompt: Funda inxalenye nganye uze ukhethe indlela yokufunda ebonakala inokwenzeka kakhulu phambi kokuba uqhubeke.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.hint.0: Latha ngokusebenzisa kuphela imigca oyifundileyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba umthethi wayevumelana nantoni: umbuzo njengoko ubuziwe, okanye iinyani?
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.0.after: KwisiKorea esiqhelekileyo 네 yodwa ivumelana nombuzo njengoko ubuziwe ('네, 안 가요'), ngoko a yindlela eqhelekileyo yokufunda. b yindlela umthethi owaziyo i-'yes' yesiNgesi anokuthetha ngayo. Nangayiphi na, 네 yodwa ayixeleli umamkeli ukuba yeyiphi.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: 네 yodwa ayibonisi nkohliso; impendulo engagqibanga iya kusebenzisa amagama anje ngo-'글쎄요' okanye u-'아직요'.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Akukho nto kwi-네 elula ebuzayo; ithoni kuya kufuneka inyuke kwaye umbuzo usebenzise amagama.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Zombini a no-d zinokuhambelana, kodwa 아니요 ka-나 ngokukhawuleza kunye nengcinezelo zikhomba ngakumbi ku-a: 네 yodwa yeviwe njengo-'andiyi' nangona 나 ethetha 'ewe, ndiya'.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.o.a: 부장님 weva 네 njengo-'akayi'; 나 wayethetha 'ewe, ndiya'.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 부장님 weva 네 njengo-'uya', kwaye 나 ngenene akayi.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Umgca wokugqibela ka-나 uthi 가요 kunye 갈 거예요, ngoko 나 uya.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Akukho namnye kubo okhankanya umhla okanye ixesha.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.o.d: 나 utshintshe ingqondo emva kokuba 부장님 ebonelele ngokumthethela.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kwixesha elizayo xa kuvela umbuzo ongaphikisiyo, yiyiphi indlela yokuphendula ekuphepha le ngxaki?
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Ukuphinda isenzi kunye nokuphika kwaso okanye ukuvuma kwaso kuchaza inyani ngqo, ngoko umamkeli akaxhomekeki ekuqwalaseleni ukuba 네 ibhekisa kuntoni.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Phendula 네 uze uchaze kamva kuphela ukuba umamkeli ubonakala ebhidekile.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ukungaqondani sele kwenzeka kwi-네 yokuqala; ukuchaza kamva kuyalungisa kunokuba kuthintele.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ukuxokozela akutshintshi into yokuba 네 inokuviwa njengevumelana nombuzo okanye neenyani.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Rhoqo phendula 아니요, nokuba umbuzo ngowuphi.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ukuhlala uthi 아니요 kuya kunika impendulo engalunganga nanini na xa impendulo yenene kukuba awuyi.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Yithi 네 okanye 아니요 uze uphinde isenzi: '네, 안 가요' okanye '아니요, 가요'.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.reflect: 네 okanye 아니요 yodwa emva kombuzo ongaphikisiyo ('안 가세요?') incanyathiselwa kumbuzo wonke, hayi iinyani kuphela, ngoko inokuviwa ngeendlela ezimbini eziphikisanayo. Ukongeza isenzi ('아니요, 가요') kuthintela ukungaqondani.
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.prompt: Kwangoko emva kokungaqondani, uthumela 부장님 umyalezo omfutshane ngesiKorea (ngembeko) uthi uthethe ukuba UYA kwaye uxolisa ngokubhideka.
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.hint.0: Bhekisa kuye 부장님 uze uxolise ngokubhideka ngebinzana elifutshane.
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.hint.1: Chaza inyani ngesenzi (oya kukwenza ngomso), hayi ngegama lempendulo elilodwa.
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba umyalezo wam uthi ngokucacileyo ndiya?
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ndiyichaza na inyani ngesenzi endaweni ye-네 yodwa?
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ukuxolisa kwam kunembeko ngaphandle kokuba kude kakhulu?
